sub_graphs.title: Paris EIP-1559 Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models transaction processing with EIP-1559 fee market dynamics

nodes.label: Transaction Received
nodes.description: EIP-1559 transaction pending processing

nodes.label: Check Transaction
nodes.description: Validate: available gas, sender recovery, nonce match, fee constraints, balance check, EOA

nodes.label: Check Fee Cap Constraints
nodes.description: Verify max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas

nodes.label: Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction passed all pre-execution checks including EIP-1559 constraints

nodes.label: Transaction Invalid
nodes.description: Transaction failed validation

nodes.label: Deduct Maximum Fee
nodes.description: Deduct gas * max_fee_per_gas from sender upfront

nodes.label: Execute Message Call
nodes.description: Execute transaction with access list processing

nodes.label: Transaction Executed
nodes.description: Transaction execution complete

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Refund
nodes.description: Refund max 20% of gas consumed (reduced from 50%)

nodes.label: Refund Unused Gas
nodes.description: Return unused gas * max_fee_per_gas + (max_fee - effective_fee) * gas_used

nodes.label: Pay Priority Fee to Coinbase
nodes.description: Transfer priority_fee_per_gas * gas_used to coinbase

nodes.label: Delete Marked Accounts
nodes.description: Remove accounts marked for deletion during execution

nodes.label: Transaction Complete
nodes.description: Transaction fully processed

external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
external_entities.description: External account that signed and submitted the EIP-1559 transaction

sub_graphs.title: Paris EIP-1559 Base Fee Dynamics
sub_graphs.description: Models the base fee calculation and adjustment mechanism

nodes.label: Parent Block Data Read
nodes.description: Parent block gas usage and base fee retrieved

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Target
nodes.description: Target = parent_gas_limit / ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER (2)

nodes.label: Gas Target Computed
nodes.description: Block gas target calculated

nodes.label: Compare Usage to Target
nodes.description: Determine if parent gas used is above or below target

nodes.label: Usage Above Target
nodes.description: Parent block used more gas than target - base fee increases

nodes.label: Usage Below Target
nodes.description: Parent block used less gas than target - base fee decreases

nodes.label: Increase Base Fee
nodes.description: new_base_fee = parent_base_fee + (gas_delta / target) / BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR (8)

nodes.label: Decrease Base Fee
nodes.description: new_base_fee = parent_base_fee - (gas_delta / target) / BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR (8)

nodes.label: Apply Minimum Adjustment
nodes.description: Ensure minimum adjustment is 1 wei when change would be non-zero

nodes.label: Base Fee Computed
nodes.description: New base fee calculated for this block

nodes.label: Validate Base Fee
nodes.description: Verify block's base fee matches calculated value

nodes.label: Base Fee Valid
nodes.description: Block's base fee is correct

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: EIP-1559 transaction awaiting validation

nodes.label: Check Gas Available
nodes.description: Verify available block gas remaining

nodes.label: Recover Sender
nodes.description: Recover sender address from signature

nodes.label: Check Nonce Match
nodes.description: Verify sender nonce matches account nonce

nodes.label: Check Fee Relationship
nodes.description: Verify max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas

nodes.label: Check Balance Sufficient
nodes.description: Verify balance >= gas * max_fee_per_gas + value

nodes.label: Check Sender is EOA
nodes.description: Confirm sender is not a contract

nodes.label: Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks passed

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: Transaction rejected

ambiguities.text: The exact mechanism for how the execution layer receives blocks from the consensus layer is not detailed
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Engine API is used (newPayload, forkchoiceUpdated methods) as defined in EIP-3675 and execution-apis specification.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when base fee would decrease below zero is not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume base fee has an implicit floor of 0 (or 1 wei in practice) and cannot become negative.

ambiguities.text: The EMPTY_OMMER_HASH is described as 'Keccak256 hash of empty RLP-encoded list' without the actual value

implicit_assumptions.description: The beacon chain consensus layer correctly validates blocks before passing execution payloads
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid blocks could be proposed to the execution layer, wasting resources or causing consensus splits

implicit_assumptions.description: A sufficient number of validators are honest and online to maintain consensus
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Consensus could stall or be manipulated if validator set is compromised

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot manipulate the base fee mechanism to destabilize the fee market
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas price manipulation, transaction censorship, or denial of service

implicit_assumptions.description: The Engine API communication between consensus and execution layers is reliable and timely
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block proposal delays, missed slots, or consensus/execution layer divergence

implicit_assumptions.description: The 20% max gas refund is sufficient to prevent refund-based DoS attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential for gas amplification attacks through carefully crafted self-destructing contracts
